text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, Fusaichi Pandora
burst in with her smartphone in hand.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Here you go♡ Take care of it~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
F-i-l-m-i-n-g for Umatok☆
I found this super hype song, you see~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If you're filming me,
I can dance suuuper cutely, you know! ♡♡
Come on, you'll hold the camera, right?
choice_data_list: I don't mind taking the picture, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yay☆
Make sure to take a super cute pic, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we started the shoot, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmmh... Something feels off~~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So plain~. Not feeling it at all~.
Severely lacking in photogenic appeal. I mean—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, got any good ideas?
Something way more lovey-dovey and super bubbly~~!
choice_data_list: How about... we all dance together?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That sounds great!
A collab would be super insta-worthy♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~♡ Deciiided♪ Camera person, come over here~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way!
Why on earth do I have to dance with you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's cute, and that witch vibe is insane!
Visuals on point plus that mystical air... isn't that just too aesthetic!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nooo waaaay!
I'm totally not in the mood.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!? No way, don't say nooo!
I wanna dance with Sweep-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Magic effects are a must for this song!
I want Sweep-chan to cast them for me!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Only a magical girl can help me with something like this~~!
So please! Pretty please? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Cast a spell on meee♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-UmaTok? No way, no way, no way!
I'm terrible at stuff like that...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"You danced with me in the lesson room
the other day, right?
Your advice was so incredibly helpful!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We just happened to be practicing the same song... Anyway, I'm sorry. I just can't do it...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaiiiit~~!!
Dober-senpai... are you really sure?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Having you close by makes me feel
so super safe and reassured, Senpai. *sniffle*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Urgh...
...Don't look at me like that..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
One-two, three-four♪
Then go *kyapi*♡, strike a pose☆, like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. I think it's a good routine... but
it's super, uh, cute, or should I say...
Are you sure I really have to do this too...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the magic effects won't look good here!
If you're taking pictures, do it by the flowerbed out back!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waha, your advice is way too reliable~~~!!
This is definitely gonna make the ultimate Umatok video!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who were bewildered at first find themselves helping Fusaichi Pandora before they even realize it.
choice_data_list: (...How does she manage to get so close to people so fast?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, once the finished video
was published on UmaTok—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waha! Crazy! Ten thousand likes~~!!
The notifications won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Could this account that 'Uma-liked' my post
actually be Sweep-chan?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! A message from Dober-senpai!
"My friend told me it's going viral.
It was kind of fun, I guess"... she says!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm so haaappy~~!
—Wait, from other girls too?! Whoa☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Fusaichi Pandora innocently frolicking over the flood of comments coming in on UmaTok,
I couldn't help but feel deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Diving right in without hesitation before anyone,
and naturally drawing them into her pace.
That magnetic charisma of hers—
choice_data_list: (I wonder what her charm really is.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Trainer?
choice_data_list: If you're taking photos again, I'd be happy to help.
I'd love to learn how you pull everyone into your pace like that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, totally fired up~!
That's just way too awesome~~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then,
should we supersize the scale even more next time!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Deck out the outfit to the max, and do tons of on-location shoots!
I'll leave all the management up to you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, for real~~?!
I got a feeling the legend of Pandora-chan is about to begin! ♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, did you finally notice~?
Pandora-chan's charm is crazy-cute and the absolute strongest♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Next thing I knew, everyone was dancing! Guess I just have a natural talent for hyping up the crowd~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I could totally get way more people hyped!
Forget the academy, I'll hype up the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! I've got a feeling my greatness
is gonna spread worldwide☆
Yeah♪
